data.name: AnyRouter Auto
data.description: Top usage + top stable platform models mixing free-tier and credit-billed routes, with health-aware fallback. Tools are optional — pass `tools` when you need them. Billed at each hop's rate ($0 on free hops).

data.name: Claude Opus 5.5
data.description: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 is the successor to Claude Opus 5 for long-running agentic coding and knowledge work. It delivers Fable 5.1-level performance at 40% lower cost ($4 / $20 per million input / output tokens), with adaptive thinking always on, 1M-token context, vision input, and tool use. Built for multi-step changes in large codebases, code review and bug finding, financial and scientific analysis, and reading dense charts and diagrams.

data.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
data.description: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 is the successor to Claude Sonnet 5 — the best combination of speed and intelligence in the lineup. It is the direct upgrade for well-scoped everyday work (building features, fixing bugs, drafting and review) at the same $2 / $10 per million input / output rates, with adaptive thinking on by default at `high` effort, 1M-token context, 128K max output, vision input, and tool use. Faster than Opus 5.5, cheaper, same window.

data.name: BGE-M3
data.description: BAAI's BGE-M3 is a multilingual text embedding model that handles dense, sparse, and multi-vector retrieval in one model, across 100+ languages and an 8,192-token input window. It returns a 1,024-dimension dense vector.

data.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
data.description: Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash is a multimodal model for fast agentic workflows, coding, and complex multi-step reasoning, with a 1,048,576-token context window.

data.name: MiniMax M2
data.description: MiniMax M2 is a large language model for complex software engineering, agentic tool use, and office productivity workflows. Supports complex agent harnesses, dynamic tool search, Agent Teams, and high-fidelity coding and document-editing tasks.

data.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
data.description: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol delivers near-Astra performance for complex coding and agentic work at a lower cost, with configurable reasoning, tool use, image input, and a 1.05M-token context window.

data.name: GPT-OSS-120b
data.description: OpenAI gpt-oss-120b open-weight MoE via SiliconFlow free tier — reasoning and tool-use support.

data.name: Qwen3.5 Plus
data.description: Qwen3.5 Plus is Alibaba's mid-tier "plus" model from the Qwen3.5 generation, with a 256K context window and strong reasoning, coding, and tool use.

data.name: Fugu Max
data.description: Fugu Max is the largest tier of Sakana AI's Fugu line — a 1M-token-context model that takes text, images, and files and returns text. It joins sakana/fugu and sakana/fugu-ultra as a distinct tier, and is not a v2 of fugu-ultra (that one is folded into the existing row as an alias, not a new listing).

data.name: Solar Decide
data.description: Upstage Solar Decide is a decision model served as a System One endpoint on Solar Mini 4: send application state and typed questions (noul / choice / score) and get structured answers back — not generated chat text. It has a 524,288-token context window. Call POST /api/v1/decisions (POST /api/v1/systemone is the same handler).

data.name: MiMo V2.6 Flash
data.description: MiMo V2.6 Flash is Xiaomi's full-modality reasoning model for high-frequency invocations and large-scale professional workloads. It keeps the 1M-token context window and up to 128K output tokens of MiMo V2.6 Pro at roughly a third of the input price, making it the best-balanced pick when reasoning quality matters more than peak capability.

data.name: GLM 5.3 Prime
data.description: GLM 5.3 Prime is the top reasoning tier of Z.ai's GLM 5.3 line, above the Flash and FlashX cuts, with a 1M-token context window. It sits alongside z-ai/glm-5.3 and z-ai/glm-5.3-flash as a separately priced official variant rather than a packaging of them, so it keeps its own listing row.
